fields.title: Payment retry and idempotency specification
chunks:
## Idempotency
A charge receives one idempotency key before its first provider request. Every retry of that logical charge sends exactly that same key.

## Retry budget
Retry only transient provider failures. Stop after three attempts and record the provider response for reconciliation.
